description: This file implements context management for conversations, including token counting, sliding window truncation, and conditional condensation based on token thresholds. It provides functions to estimate token counts, truncate conversations non-destructively, and manage context by condensing or truncating messages to stay within token limits.

methods.name: estimateTokenCount
methods.description: Estimates the number of tokens in given content using the provided API handler.

methods.name: truncateConversation
methods.description: Performs non-destructive sliding window truncation by tagging messages as hidden and inserting a truncation marker.

methods.name: willManageContext
methods.description: Determines if context management (condensation or truncation) will likely be triggered based on token usage thresholds.

methods.name: manageContext
methods.description: Main function to conditionally condense or truncate conversation messages to stay within token limits.
